final: SELECT oi.order_id, AVG(oi.product_quantity) AS order_avg_quantity, AVG(oi.product_quantity) - overall.avg_quantity AS difference_from_overall FROM Order_Items AS oi CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(product_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM Order_Items) AS overall WHERE overall.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oi.order_id ORDER BY difference_from_overall DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
